requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding SOA RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the RDATA fields in the order MNAME, RNAME, SERIAL, REFRESH, RETRY, EXPIRE, MINIMUM.
requirements.why_checkable: A wire-format encoder or parser can be checked for each field and its position.

requirements.quote:
MNAME           The <domain-name> of the name server that was the
                original or primary source of data for this zone.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the SOA MNAME field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent MNAME as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The MNAME wire representation can be checked as a domain-name field.

requirements.quote:
MNAME           The <domain-name> of the name server that was the
                original or primary source of data for this zone.
requirements.condition: Setting or interpreting the SOA MNAME field for a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: Use MNAME to identify the name server that was the original or primary source of the zone data.
requirements.why_checkable: The selected server identity can be compared with MNAME in the SOA record.

requirements.quote:
RNAME           A <domain-name> which specifies the mailbox of the
                person responsible for this zone.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the SOA RNAME field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent RNAME as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The RNAME wire representation can be checked as a domain-name field.

requirements.quote:
RNAME           A <domain-name> which specifies the mailbox of the
                person responsible for this zone.
requirements.condition: Setting or interpreting the SOA RNAME field for a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: Use RNAME to specify the mailbox of the person responsible for the zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured responsible-person mailbox can be compared with the meaning assigned to RNAME.

requirements.quote:
SERIAL          The unsigned 32 bit version number of the original copy
                of the zone.  Zone transfers preserve this value.  This
                value wraps and should be compared using sequence space
                arithmetic.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the SOA SERIAL field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent SERIAL as an unsigned 32-bit integer.
requirements.why_checkable: The field width and unsigned interpretation can be checked at the integer boundaries.

requirements.quote:
SERIAL          The unsigned 32 bit version number of the original copy
                of the zone.  Zone transfers preserve this value.  This
                value wraps and should be compared using sequence space
                arithmetic.
requirements.condition: Setting or interpreting the SOA SERIAL field.
requirements.required_behavior: Use SERIAL as the version number of the original copy of the zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The zone version stored or compared by the implementation can be traced to SERIAL.

requirements.quote:
SERIAL          The unsigned 32 bit version number of the original copy
                of the zone.  Zone transfers preserve this value.  This
                value wraps and should be compared using sequence space
                arithmetic.
requirements.condition: Transferring a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve the SOA SERIAL value in the transferred zone.
requirements.why_checkable: Source and transferred SOA serial values can be compared for equality.

requirements.quote:
SERIAL          The unsigned 32 bit version number of the original copy
                of the zone.  Zone transfers preserve this value.  This
                value wraps and should be compared using sequence space
                arithmetic.
requirements.condition: The SOA SERIAL value advances beyond its unsigned 32-bit range.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow SERIAL to wrap within its 32-bit sequence space.
requirements.why_checkable: The serial-number representation and advancement behavior can be checked across wraparound.

requirements.quote:
SERIAL          The unsigned 32 bit version number of the original copy
                of the zone.  Zone transfers preserve this value.  This
                value wraps and should be compared using sequence space
                arithmetic.
requirements.condition: Comparing SOA SERIAL values.
requirements.required_behavior: SERIAL values should be compared using sequence-space arithmetic.
requirements.why_checkable: Comparisons spanning serial-number wraparound reveal whether sequence-space arithmetic is used; the source expresses this as a recommendation.

requirements.quote:
REFRESH         A 32 bit time interval before the zone should be
                refreshed.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the SOA REFRESH field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent REFRESH as a 32-bit time interval.
requirements.why_checkable: The REFRESH field width and interval interpretation can be inspected in the SOA codec.

requirements.quote:
REFRESH         A 32 bit time interval before the zone should be
                refreshed.
requirements.condition: Scheduling refresh of a zone using its SOA record.
requirements.required_behavior: The zone should be refreshed after the interval specified by REFRESH.
requirements.why_checkable: The refresh timer can be compared with the configured REFRESH interval; the source expresses this as a recommendation.

requirements.quote:
RETRY           A 32 bit time interval that should elapse before a
                failed refresh should be retried.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the SOA RETRY field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent RETRY as a 32-bit time interval.
requirements.why_checkable: The RETRY field width and interval interpretation can be inspected in the SOA codec.

requirements.quote:
RETRY           A 32 bit time interval that should elapse before a
                failed refresh should be retried.
requirements.condition: A zone refresh has failed.
requirements.required_behavior: The interval specified by RETRY should elapse before retrying the failed refresh.
requirements.why_checkable: The elapsed time between a failed refresh and its retry can be compared with RETRY; the source expresses this as a recommendation.

requirements.quote:
EXPIRE          A 32 bit time value that specifies the upper limit on
                the time interval that can elapse before the zone is no
                longer authoritative.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the SOA EXPIRE field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent EXPIRE as a 32-bit time value.
requirements.why_checkable: The EXPIRE field width and time-value interpretation can be inspected in the SOA codec.

requirements.quote:
EXPIRE          A 32 bit time value that specifies the upper limit on
                the time interval that can elapse before the zone is no
                longer authoritative.
requirements.condition: Using SOA EXPIRE to determine whether a zone remains authoritative.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat EXPIRE as the upper limit on the elapsed interval before the zone is no longer authoritative.
requirements.why_checkable: The expiration threshold and transition out of authoritative status can be checked against EXPIRE; this excerpt does not specify the interval starting event.

requirements.quote:
MINIMUM         The unsigned 32 bit minimum TTL field that should be
                exported with any RR from this zone.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the SOA MINIMUM field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent MINIMUM as an unsigned 32-bit minimum TTL value.
requirements.why_checkable: The MINIMUM field width, unsigned interpretation, and TTL role can be inspected in the SOA codec.

requirements.quote: SOA records cause no additional section processing.
requirements.condition: Processing an SOA resource record.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Cause additional section processing as a consequence of the SOA record.
requirements.why_checkable: Response construction can be checked to ensure that SOA processing itself initiates no additional-section work.

requirements.quote: All times are in units of seconds.
requirements.condition: Interpreting time values in SOA RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret all SOA time values in seconds.
requirements.why_checkable: Conversions for REFRESH, RETRY, EXPIRE, and MINIMUM can be checked against second-based values.
